Definition: from the same as G140; a schismatic:--heretic (the Greek word itself).
BiblicalUsage: hairetikós means heretic (the Greek word itself). In Titus 3:10, the text says "A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of hairetikós I do not force more than it gives: heretic.
